title: Ep 13 — Anthropic's run rate clears sixty-five billion, and the pricing-spy tool that hit two million a year
description: Anthropic's revenue run rate reportedly passes sixty-five billion dollars, OpenAI launches a dedicated ChatGPT for Teens and publishes a warning on AI-accelerated cyberattacks with a new Codex Security plugin, and Cursor builds itself a lightweight GitHub with Origin. Plus a deep dive on competitor pricing-intelligence tool Price2Spy, founder Nemanja Rakocevic's bootstrapped climb from fifty-five thousand dollars in 2012 to two million dollars a year, and a seventh quiet week for the Fundraising Regulator's still-pending prize-draw ruling.
